name: building-blocks-status-primitives
title: Status Primitives
description: Small Tailwind status atoms for inline labels, health pills, emphasis rows, signal tiles, and compact stat pairs.
useWhen: Small Tailwind status atoms for inline labels, health pills, emphasis rows, signal tiles, and compact stat pairs.
avoidWhen: Avoid status primitives when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Status Primitives uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
